## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 6-fascicle proto-*Avataṃsaka* text by [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù corresponds, on the Taishō apparatus's authority, to chapter 33 of the *[60-fascicle Huáyán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0001)* (the *Lí shì-jiān pǐn* 離世間品 "Chapter on Departing from the World") and to chapter 38 of the *[80-fascicle Huáyán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0010)* (the same *Lí shì-jiān pǐn*). The chapter is, in the *Avataṃsaka* corpus, the long penultimate chapter, in which Samantabhadra expounds the bodhisattva's culminating practice — the *paramārtha* of "departing from the world" through the realisation of the perfect interpenetration (*shìshì wú'ài*) of the *dharma-realm*.

**Abstract**

The translation is conventionally datable through the *Chū sānzàng jì jí* 出三藏記集 (T2145) to *Yuán-kāng* 元康 1 (291 CE), 1st month, 14th day, when [竺法護](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%B3%95%E8%AD%B7) Zhú Fǎhù produced the text at the Cháng'ān bureau. The bracket adopted here (291 – 291) reflects this precise dating. The text is contemporary with — and probably part of the same translation campaign as — Zhú Fǎhù's *[Rúlái xīng xiǎn jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0039)* (T0291, also 291 CE) and his earlier proto-*Avataṃsaka* work; together with the *[Jiàn bèi](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0033)* / *Daśabhūmika* of 297 CE, these constitute his major *Avataṃsaka*-tradition project.

The doctrinal substance of the *Lí shì-jiān pǐn* / *Dù shì pǐn jīng* is the bodhisattva's culminating practice. The chapter consists primarily of long enumerative lists — "ten kinds of [X]," "twenty kinds of [Y]," etc. — describing the bodhisattva's mature contemplative achievement. In the structure of the *Avataṃsaka* it serves as the doctrinal recapitulation immediately preceding the great Sudhana pilgrimage of the *[closing Rù fǎjiè pǐn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0001)*: having received in the preceding 32 chapters the complete doctrinal teaching, the bodhisattva is now urged to put it all into practice through the great pilgrimage. The chapter's title — *Lí shì-jiān* in the later versions, *Dù shì* in Zhú Fǎhù's earlier rendering — preserves slightly different but compatible nuances: "departing from the world" (*lí*) emphasises the transcendental; "crossing over the world" (*dù*) emphasises the soteriological practice of leading beings out of saṃsāra.

The Taishō text (T0292) is established on the standard apparatus.
